pages.text: In Bung's village, all the roads were water. Boats sold fruit and noodles. Bung lived on Mom's noodle boat.
Every morning, Grandpa's boat went round the market. Bung longed to ride it. "Ddori, let us ride together!"
Grandpa pushed through the water with a long piece of wood—an oar. Bung hopped aboard.
Ddori was still on Mom's boat, toddling over on short legs.
The boat glided away. "Ah! Ah!" Mom quickly picked up Ddori. Ddori stretched out both hands.
Bung looked back. Ddori grew smaller and smaller.
Red and yellow fruit filled the market. But Bung kept looking behind.
Grandpa stood the oar in the water. "Where is Ddori?"
Mom lifted Ddori onto Grandpa's boat. Bung stretched out both arms to take Ddori.
The boat went round the market. Bung and Ddori sat side by side, looking around.
